sources.excerpt: CP-74 Action Replay by Caline | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Caline CP-74 Action Replay LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS DISTORTION EQUALIZER Description The CP-74 "Red Thorn" Distortion pedal has been developed to give that classic Dyna Red distortion sound. The 4 knob configuration gives you all the tone options needed to reproduce the famous Plexitone sound and that identifiable classic rock distortion. The 4 controls are: Volume, Drive, Treble and Lomid. The desired combination can produce a wide and dynamic sound from just above overdrive to a crunchy distortion with lots of low dirt and growl when required.
